findings.location: Risks and sensitive actions; Increments A–C
findings.problem: The plan changes the project’s authoritative authorization and permission specifications (`trust-and-approval`, `command-permissions`, `harness-modules`, and owner-run/command-gate descriptions), but it neither asks the owner whether to run a security review nor notes that no such installed review module is available. The repository policy requires that checkpoint for material authorization changes.
findings.suggestion: Add a pre-implementation checkpoint to ask the owner whether to run an installed `security-review` module; if none is installed, record that fact and proceed only on the owner’s direction.

findings.problem: The plan says text dependent on the former global configuration is deferred to the second plan, but Increment A changes the statement about the superpowers plugin in `~/.claude` specifically because the global configuration was reset. The scope is internally inconsistent.
findings.suggestion: Explicitly make reset-caused factual corrections an exception to that non-goal, or move this correction to the second plan.

summary: The plan needs the required security-review decision checkpoint; it also has one scope inconsistency around the reset-dependent plugin statement.
